physiology:
The traditions seat this code in the lungs. Not the heart, where you might expect a card about authority to sit, but the lungs, the only organ in the body that takes hold of the world and lets it go again, twenty thousand times a day, without being asked. Grip and release. The card is already there, in the chest, before you have thought a thing about it.

The shadow has its bodily floor in the way breath narrows when control comes in. The shoulders climb. The ribs stop moving freely. Air gets taken in through a smaller opening, and is held a beat longer than it needs to be, and goes out short. The chest becomes a held room. People who have spent years gripping their territory know this feeling without having a name for it. Their breathing has been doing the work of standing watch for them.

The climb out is also bodily, and it is simple enough to be embarrassing. The breath lengthens. The ribs come unstuck from the back. The first long exhale of the day arrives without being arranged, and something in the chest that had been clenched without your noticing it lets down by a fraction. This is not a metaphor for letting go. It is letting go. The code was always going to be taught in the place where the body practises holding and releasing as one motion.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the organ, this code answers to a single amino acid, Arginine. Arginine is the body's source for nitric oxide, the small signalling molecule that tells the blood vessels to widen, to slacken their walls, to let more through. Without it the vessels stay narrow. With it they open.

There is a teaching in that, and it is the same teaching the card has been giving the whole time. The chemistry of authority, in the body, is the chemistry of opening. Of relaxing what was held tight. Of letting more flow through a vessel that had been gripping itself shut. The Gift was never going to come from squeezing harder. It comes from the molecule whose job is to release.

Arginine is also one the body can mostly make for itself, but not always enough of, not under stress, not when it is healing. So even the chemistry of opening is something that sometimes has to be received from outside, taken in, supplied. The code runs all the way down to this: the standing that other people will follow is the standing of a body that has learned, lower than thinking, how to open its grip.
